mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id AND rp.application_id = p.application_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id AND r.tenant_id = rp.tenant_id AND r.tenant_application_id = rp.tenant_application_id AND r.application_id = rp.application_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND ur.tenant_application_id = r.tenant_application_id AND ur.application_id = r.application_id WHERE p.application_id = #{applicationId} AND p.available = 1 AND p.is_delete = 0 AND r.available = 1 AND r.is_delete = 0 AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.tenant_application_id = #{instanceId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId}
